content: {"episode_id": "ep-05065", "cpt": "93271", "denial_carc": "CO-97", "necessity_paragraph": "The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia and sick sinus syndrome, occurring against a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease.
